svg.title: Making an occupied zone the destination in Zonogy. With every zone full, holding the modifier keys and clicking a window makes its zone the destination, marked by a glow. Replying to an email in Mail then opens the reply there, and the window it replaces is minimized. Doing the same on Mail itself makes the next reply take Mail's place.
svg.text: Hold the modifier keys and click a zone to make it the destination
The next window opens there, and the one it replaces is minimized
Do the same on Mail itself, and the reply takes Mail's place
